rationale: ORCL gapped up ~2.33% from a prior close that itself reflected a ~6.9% decline on capital raise concerns, creating a conflicted setup: the gap suggests some buying interest but the stock is sitting mid-range (47.6%), below the 9-EMA ($122.41), and near VWAP ($121.87) with no clear directional momentum in the last two candles. The negative fundamental overhang (AI spending sustainability, construction delays) and the wide bid-ask spread (18.1 bps) reduce edge in either direction, and with an existing working long in SHOP already consuming buying power, adding exposure to a similarly uncertain name at open is not warranted.
